storage.readonlyNoLocks: This browser cannot coordinate several tabs safely, so Weeklid is read-only here. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
storage.unsupported: This data was saved by a newer version of Weeklid and is read-only until you update.
storage.legacyChanged: An older version of Weeklid is open in another tab. Changes made there are not carried over.
storage.conflict: Another tab changed your data first. The latest version was loaded — please try again.
storage.saveFailed: Could not save ({reason}). Your previous data is unchanged.
storage.unavailableTitle: Weeklid can't use this browser's storage
storage.unavailableBody: Weeklid stopped so nothing gets lost. Your data on this device was not changed. Try again in a moment.
storage.lastChangeNotSaved: Your last change was not saved. Everything before it is safe.
storage.exportWithoutCalendars: Some calendar texts could not be read, so they were exported empty.

recovery.title: Your saved data can't be read
recovery.description: Weeklid stopped to protect it and changed nothing. You can download the raw data, restore the last backup, or start with an empty planner.
recovery.confirmBody: Download the raw data first if you may need it. A copy is kept in the backup slot when no valid backup exists.
